primitive.semantics: age=step-episode_start; drain iff episode_start>0 AND age>ttl (strict >); default ttl=32; drained acc:=0 and episode_start:=0

wire_site.note: ARM2 calls apply_ttl_age_drain(..., ttl=32) each step before select/writeback

receipt_measurements_n_applied_drains.meaning: COUNT OF FLIP-APPLIED MASKS (writeback drains), NOT TTL age>T force-zero events
receipt_measurements_n_applied_drains.also_aliases_in_loop: n_flips is incremented by the same drained total (screen_execution_loop.py:260)

FINDING_no_dedicated_ttl_force_zero_coun.detail: Live receipt schema has no field that counts apply_ttl_age_drain force-zeros. Packet-stage must either add a named TTL drain counter or redefine A_ttl requires_all to use a measurement derivable from existing tensors (e.g. pre/post episode_start deltas) — do NOT silently invent counters in the fence.
FINDING_no_dedicated_ttl_force_zero_coun.implication_for_A_ttl: CONTRACT A_ttl 'n_applied_drains > 0 OR equivalent age-drain event counter' cannot bind to measurements.n_applied_drains as TTL evidence; that field is flip-path only.

measurement.discrimination: same pre-state yields young_preserved_ttl=True under apply_ttl_age_drain AND young_wiped_z=True under age-independent wipe; post young values differ across operators

source_defects.note: Primitive exists and is exact vs oracle; missing is receipt telemetry for TTL drains — packet-stage wiring concern, not fence license to change transfer law.
